thread:
mika: FYI - PolarisBio reported a $7,860 overage on their Jul reserved invoice, claiming it was due to a maintenance-triggered failover. Can finance + SRE triage? @samir @olivia

samir: Please paste the invoice excerpt and the alleged window. I'll pull meter lines.

mika: From customer upload:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0729
Reserved commit: $6,000
Burst/overage: $7,860
Period: 2026-07-01 - 2026-07-31
Claimed incident: 2026-07-15 01:20-02:45 UTC (failover)
```

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-620: scheduled-maintenance -> regional-failover-eu -> us-east. start: 2026-07-15T01:18Z end: 2026-07-15T02:50Z. Affected: polaris-dedicated-prod.

olivia: Metering snapshot: compute burst $5,100; egress $1,020; misc $240 => our total $6,360. There's a $1,500 delta vs their invoice. Could be billing export window.

samir: Proposed goodwill: waive egress ($1,020) + 40% compute credit (~$2,040) = ~$3,060 total. Offer one month Dedicated Insights retention as courtesy.

mika: Customer asks for full waive. They're a long-term customer but we should avoid precedent. The proposed goodwill seems fair.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo CM-2026-1890 created: compute credit $2,040; egress waived $1,020; total $3,060. Pending approval.

samir: Approving CM-2026-1890. Apply to INV-2026-0729 and push revised invoice.

billing-bot: CM-2026-1890 applied to INV-2026-0729. Journal entry JE-2026-1442 posted. Updated invoice available in billing portal.

mika: Customer confirmed receipt and accepted the credit. Closing loop. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
